schema_note: PSS opportunity backlog. Phase 1 seed. Source of raw ideas for the partner pipeline. items.title: Blog section structural hygiene: reconnect the orphaned /blog content (index/sitemap reconciliation, hub-to-post links, internal cross-links, AUTO-BLOG-CARDS mechanism decision, optional nav entry)
items.source: Phase 1.5 real pilot F-0901, 3 rounds (Investigator/Analyst/Verifier x3), 2026-09-01
items.problem_addressed: 96 real blog posts have zero hub-to-post links (blog.html), zero cross-links between posts, no primary-nav /blog entry (only 3 of 257 site pages even link to the hub), a stale 120-item content index (24 entries with no matching file), 17 real post files missing from sitemap.xml, and a documented AUTO-BLOG-CARDS content-injection mechanism that was apparently never executed. A live, direct GSC aggregate query (2026-08-03..2026-08-30, DEU) confirms blog's tracked search share is 0% of both clicks and impressions in that window.
items.expected_business_outcome: Uncertain / not demonstrated. A live GSC page-detail query in the same window shows PSS's own commercial city/service pages (not blog) also carry the site's real search visibility; the blog's contribution to leads/quotes/jobs/revenue is unproven and, per the live 0%-share data point, currently negligible. This item is tracked as engineering hygiene (a functioning site should not have an orphaned content section, a stale index, or a broken automation), not as a claimed traffic or revenue opportunity.
items.impact_estimate: low (per 3-round live-verified pilot; structural defects are real but no evidence of business impact from fixing them)
items.effort: small-medium (blog.html hub links, nav entry if pursued, sitemap.xml regeneration, blog-index.json reconciliation, decide retire-vs-execute for AUTO-BLOG-CARDS)
items.risk: low (additive/corrective static file edits only, fully git-revertible, no external service, no tracking/conversion logic touched)
items.missing_data: Whether a structural fix would move blog_impression_share at all (see F-0901 round 3 Verifier: INSUFFICIENT_DATA on the causal question, 3 unresolved alternatives — sitewide-event confound, page-filter validation against the literal blog URL list, single-window/thin-sample generalizability).
items.next_verification: If ever revisited: Investigator re-runs the same live GSC aggregate methodology (site vs blog, dimensions: [], page contains /blog, DEU) over a longer or additional window before recommending implementation.
items.proposed_test: Not authorized for implementation. If later approved as hygiene work: add blog.html hub-to-post links + limited cross-links + sitemap.xml/blog-index.json reconciliation + a decision to retire or execute AUTO-BLOG-CARDS; nav entry optional, only if a future re-test shows non-trivial blog share.
items.success_metric: Not tracked as a business success metric at this time (TECHNICAL HYGIENE ONLY, not a growth investment) — CLAUDE.md metric priority: profit -> job revenue -> jobs won -> valid leads -> quotes -> real calls/form submissions -> micro-conversions -> traffic -> impressions.
